returns.title: Return & Refund Policy
returns.lastUpdated: Lore Organics B.V. — Last updated: June 2026

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.body: At Lore Organics we stand behind the quality of every product we make. If something isn't right with your order, we'll always make it right.

returns.title: Returns
returns.hygiene: Because our products are intimate personal hygiene items, we're unable to accept returns or exchanges once a product's seal has been opened — even if you've only opened one. This is in accordance with EU consumer law (Directive 2011/83/EU, Article 16(e)), which exempts sealed hygiene products from the standard right of withdrawal once unsealed.
returns.unopened: Unopened, sealed products may be returned within 14 days of delivery. Return shipping costs are covered by you, and we'll issue your refund once we've received the item back.
returns.responsibility: We'll always take full responsibility if:
cases: Your order doesn't arrive at all
returns.contactBefore: In any of these cases, please contact us within 14 days of delivery at
returns.contactAfter: with your order number and a photo where applicable. We'll send a replacement or issue a full refund immediately — no questions asked.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.body: Once a refund is approved, it will be processed to your original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. If you haven't received your refund after 10 business days, please contact your bank or payment provider first, as processing times can vary.

subscriptions.title: Subscription orders
subscriptions.before: You may cancel your subscription at any time before your next scheduled renewal. To cancel, contact us at
subscriptions.after: or manage your subscription directly in your account. Cancellations take effect 14 days after we receive your request; any renewal already processed before then will ship as scheduled, with cancellation applying from the following cycle.

nonReturnable.title: Non-returnable items
nonReturnable.intro: We don't accept returns or offer refunds for:
items: Products damaged due to misuse or improper storage
Change of mind (for opened or unsealed products)

lost.title: Lost or delayed orders
lost.before: If your order hasn't arrived within the expected delivery timeframe, please contact us at
lost.after: and we'll investigate immediately with our logistics partner.
delivery: Netherlands: expected delivery within 1 to 2 business days.
Germany: expected delivery within 2 to 4 business days.
lost.statutory: This policy doesn't affect your statutory rights as a consumer under EU law.
